$description: Lime color theme. Emitted under [data-color="lime"]. Every axis is the same shape: `600` for the resting action surface, `700` for hover, `500` for the focus ring, and white text. The five axes sit 72° apart on the hue wheel (the accent pentagon, anchored at blue), so no two accents read as shades of each other and none collides with the status hues.
